'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Myanmar protests]]
**Armed protesters and [[Tatmadaw|troops]] clash in the town of [[Taze, Myanmar|Taze]] in the [[Sagaing Region]], leaving at least eleven people dead and around 20 others wounded. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-politics/eleven-killed-as-myanmar-protesters-fight-troops-with-handmade-guns-firebombs-media-idUSKBN2BV0EH (Reuters)]
**Burmese actor and prominent [[State Administration Council|junta]] critic [[Paing Takhon]] is detained by the military in [[North Dagon Township]], [[Yangon]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-56672054 (BBC News)]
*[[2021 Beninese presidential election]]
**Protests against [[List of presidents of Benin|President]] [[Patrice Talon]]'s re-election bid in the city of [[Savè]] result in the death of one person, as [[Benin Armed Forces|troops]] attempt to disperse protesters with the use of weapons. Six people are also injured by gunfire. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/one-killed-6-wounded-in-benin-after-army-cle-1217844.html (UrduPoint)]
*[[Insurgency in Egypt (2013-present)]]
**An [[Egypt]]ian court sentences former acting [[Muslim Brotherhood]] leader [[Mahmoud Ezzat]] to life imprisonment for murder and terror offences connected to 2013 clashes in [[Cairo]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/egypt-jails-top-muslim-brotherhood-leader-for-life/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Terrorism in the Netherlands]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
**A 37-year-old man is arrested for allegedly planning a terrorist bombing against a Covid-19 vaccination site in [[Den Helder]]. [https://nltimes.nl/2021/04/08/arrest-made-terrorism-bomb-plot-dutch-covid-19-vaccination-site (NLTimes)] [https://www.dutchnews.nl/news/2021/04/man-faces-terrorism-charges-for-planning-attack-on-vaccination-centre/ (Dutch News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Egypt]]'s [[Ministry of Antiquities (Egypt)|Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities]] announces the rediscovery of [[Aten (city)|Aten]], a 3,000-year-old "lost golden city", near [[Luxor]]. Unearthed by a team led by [[Zahi Hawass]], the site is the largest city ever found in [[Egyptian history]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/egyptologists-find-vast-millenia-old-lost-golden-city/ar-BB1frDXx?ocid=uxbndlbing (AFP via MSN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The [[Saint Vincent and the Grenadines|Vincentian]] island of [[Saint Vincent (Antilles)|Saint Vincent]] declares a red alert and orders [[emergency evacuation|evacuations]] after [[seismologist]]s warn of an imminent [[volcanic eruption|eruption]] of the [[La Soufrière (volcano)|La Soufrière]] volcano. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/apr/08/st-vincent-evacuation-volcano-la-soufriere (''The Guardian'')]
*A [[Pemex]] [[petrochemical]] manufacturing refinery in [[Minatitlán, Veracruz]], [[Mexico]], suffers a large explosion followed by a fire. No deaths are reported, but seven people, including five [[firefighter]]s, are injured. [https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/Mexico-Refinery-Explosion-Leaves-Seven-Injured.html (Oil Price)]
*An explosion at a paint plant in [[Ohio]], [[United States]], kills one person and injures several more. [https://abc6onyourside.com/news/local/7-hurt-in-paint-plant-explosion-in-northeast-columbus (WSYX)]
*A bus loses control and runs off the road on the [[Interoceanic Highway]] in [[Puquio]], [[Peru]]. The resulting crash kills at least nine people and injures another 20. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-04/09/c_139867908.htm (Xinhua)]
*[[France|French]] agriculture minister [[Julien Denormandie]] announces the declaration of a national "agricultural disaster" in response to unseasonal spring [[frost]]. He says economic assistance will be made available to affected farms. [https://phys.org/news/2021-04-france-declare-agricultural-disaster-frost.html (Phys.org)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Madhya Pradesh]]
*****[[Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh|Chief Minister]] [[Shivraj Singh Chouhan]] announces a [[COVID-19 lockdown in India|lockdown]] in all urban areas across the [[Madhya Pradesh|state]] from 6:00 p.m. on Friday to 6:00 a.m. on Monday amidst an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.livemint.com/news/india/madhya-pradesh-lockdown-from-friday-to-monday-in-all-urban-areas-amid-covid-surge-check-timings-and-other-details-11617865020328.html (Livemint)]
****[[India]] reports a record 126,789 new confirmed cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 12,928,574. [https://m.timesofindia.com/india/india-reports-record-126789-new-covid-19-cases/amp_articleshow/81963173.cms (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]] reports a record 6,854 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 666,132. [https://thefinancialexpress.com.bd/national/bangladesh-logs-6854-coronavirus-cases-with-record-74-deaths-1617879596 (''The Financial Express'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports 22,586 cases, a record for the third consecutive day. In the process, the country has surpassed two million cases of COVID-19. [https://apnews.com/article/pandemics-iran-health-middle-east-coronavirus-pandemic-da55a596e2300f52d3a6a9a06e08cab4 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Food and Drug Administration (Philippines)|Food and Drug Administration]] suspends the use of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] by people under 60 years old following reports of a possible link with cases of [[blood clot]]s. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/04/08/21/astrazeneca-philippines-covid-vaccine-blood-clot-fda-age-limit (ABS-CBN News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Canada]]
*****[[Canada]] receives its first shipment of vaccine doses from the [[COVAX]] initiative. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/covax-first-shipment-canada-1.5979777 (CBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oklahoma]]
*****[[Oklahoma]] surpasses 8,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://kfor.com/news/coronavirus/cdc-oklahomas-covid-19-deaths-pass-8000/amp/ (KFOR-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nicaragua]]
****[[Nicaragua]] says that they have slowly started vaccinations for people over 60 using an [[AstraZeneca]] vaccine that was made in [[India]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/nicaragua-slowly-begins-vaccinations-for-people-over-60-nicaragua-daniel-ortega-india-astrazeneca-sandinista-b1828866.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]]
*****[[Scotland]] surpasses 10,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-56677120 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Netherlands]]
****The [[Netherlands]] officially suspends the use of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine by people under 60 years old due to concerns over reports of severe [[blood clot]]ting. [https://nltimes.nl/2021/04/08/netherlands-officially-stops-use-astrazeneca-covid-vaccine-people-60 (NL Times)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reports a record 954 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which also includes the total number of deaths from [[Good Friday]] until [[Easter Monday]], thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 56,659. [https://www.thefirstnews.com/article/poland-reports-27887-new-coronavirus-cases-on-thursday-death-toll-at-954-21079 (The First News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record 54,941 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-turkey-int-idUSKBN2BV2QY (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina]] reports 23,683 new cases of COVID-19, a record for the third consecutive day. [https://tn.com.ar/sociedad/2021/04/08/otro-dia-record-de-contagios-en-la-argentina-informaron-23500-infectados/ (TN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[Brazil]] reports a record 4,249 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 345,025. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/others/brazil-reports-highest-daily-death-toll-of-4249-people20210409050953 (ANI News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
***[[Tunisia]] approves the use of the [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] [[vaccine]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/04/08/Tunisia-approves-Johnson-Johnson-COVID-19-vaccine (Al Arabiya)]
